limits: No new online LLM quality evaluation or real embedding retrieval evaluation.
No field accuracy or pollution responsibility validation.
Video context contains quality/ROI/review/synchronization text, not image input to an LLM.
Temporary contexts are process/session scoped and are not persisted; saved history cards must be reselected after restore.
Responsive checks are desktop browser viewport simulations, not physical mobile-device or screen-reader tests.
Synthetic coordinates do not assert that a real river follows the displayed test track.
Q14 selected text/side chat, Q15 and Q16 are not implemented by this change.
